how_to_apply: Visit the official online portal at https://ipunt.samarth.edu.in or scan the QR code provided in the official notification.
Register and fill out the online application form with the required details.
Upload clear scanned copies of all educational and professional qualifications, experience certificates, caste/PWD/ex-serviceman certificates, and other required documents.
Submit the online application before 30.10.2026 (23.55 Hrs).
Take a printout of the filled online application form along with all relevant supporting documents as annexures.

Send the hard copy by Speed Post to: The Deputy Registrar (Recruitment), Room No. 021, Administrative Block, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Sector 16-C, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078, so as to reach latest by 06.11.2026 up to 5.00 PM.
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of .................................................... on Deputation / Contract basis as applicable."
important_instructions: Only applications submitted online will be considered, followed by the mandatory hard copy submission. Applicants presently employed in Government/Semi Govt./Public Sector Undertaking/University/Recognized Educational Institute must submit their applications through proper channel with a "No Objection Certificate". No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the test/interview. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. Failure to submit the printed application form with required annexures may result in rejection. Incomplete applications or documents with "password protected document" / "document not legible" will be rejected.
